# WK Construction Inc.

> Family-owned construction company in Cleveland, Texas (legal name: Wendell Kelley Construction, Inc.). Over 45 years in business. BBB Accredited since 2004, A+ rated. Builds pre-engineered metal buildings, clears and levels land, pours concrete slabs, and builds custom homes (including log homes), commercial build-outs and renovations in Liberty, Chambers and Hardin counties and nearby towns. One-year warranty on new projects and renovations. Free quotes.

Contact: (281) 592-3792 · (281) 593-5422 · wendellkelley@gmail.com · 195 Bartlett Rd, Cleveland, TX 77328 · Monday to Friday, opens 9:00 AM.

## Services
- [Metal Buildings](https://kelleyconstruction.net/metal-buildings/): Shops, warehouses, barns and commercial buildings in clear-span steel, with slab and erection by one crew.
- [Site Prep and Land](https://kelleyconstruction.net/site-prep-and-land/): Land clearing, grading, leveling and concrete slabs.
- [Custom Construction](https://kelleyconstruction.net/custom-construction/): Custom homes, log homes, commercial build-outs and renovations.

## Company
- [About](https://kelleyconstruction.net/about/): Family history, BBB record, warranty, owner contact.
- [Projects](https://kelleyconstruction.net/projects/): Examples of work, including the City of Cleveland pavilion (May 2024).

## Service area
Liberty County, Chambers County, Hardin County, Cleveland, Plum Grove, Humble, Dayton, Crosby, Shepherd (Texas).
